verdict.rationale: Cloning repositories is a fair question for a mobile app that works with Git hosting, since mobile Git clients exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents cloning over HTTPS, SSH, or the Git protocol. The docs cover browsing code, code search, pull request review, and Copilot tasks, and a community user notes the app 'doesn't really seem to be a git client.'

support.subject: As a developer, I can clone Git repositories over HTTPS, SSH, or the Git protocol
